name: boolean-query-input
title: Boolean Query Input
description: Prevents boolean searches that quietly return the wrong people by showing how the engine will group AND and OR (with the brackets it implies highlighted) and offering the grouping you meant, and by catching unclosed quotes and brackets, curly quotes, [ ] used as brackets, lowercase and/or searched as words and dangling operators, each with a one-tap fix.
